paragraphs.text: Dean Valentin was a vampire warlock teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios .

Dean Valentin of Witherbloom was an ancient and sensitive vampire who drank the blood of living creatures throughout the bayou. Valentin was a kind of sangromancer; he received visions from the blood he consumed and could use these visions to learn dark truths about a creature or place.

Valentin had no qualms about exploiting the creatures of the bayou for personal gain. His classes often focused on dissection and decay. He and Dean Lisette often clashed over his cavalier treatment of animals, but that hasn't stopped her from using his discoveries for her own research.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Valentin, like most of Strixhaven's teachers, was killed. His role as Dean of the Vein of the Witherbloom College was later taken over by Moseo .
